content: The user service uses PostgreSQL 15 for persistence.
The user service uses MySQL for persistence.
We disabled Redis caching for user records because stale cache entries caused wrong account balances.
Redis caching was disabled for user records after stale cache entries produced incorrect account balances.
Never log full card numbers or CVV values; use the last four digits only.
All new endpoints must return RFC 7807 problem+json bodies on error.
Stripe webhook handlers must be idempotent because Stripe retries deliveries.
The reporting service runs on the same PostgreSQL cluster as the user service.
The reporting service uses DuckDB for local aggregation during nightly jobs.
Nightly aggregation must finish before 06:00 UTC to leave time for downstream exports.
We migrated from Celery to Dramatiq for background jobs in 2025.
Background jobs are queued through Celery with Redis as the broker.
Use structured logging with request IDs on every service.
Python 3.8 is the runtime for all backend services.
